verses.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
verses.am: በአንድ ቤትም ይበላ፤ ከሥጋውም አንዳች ከቤት ወደ ሜዳ አታውጡ፤ አጥንትም አትስበሩበት።

verses.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ያድርጉት።

verses.en: All the congregation of Yisra'el shall keep it.
verses.am: እንግዳ ሰውም በመካከላችሁ ቢቀመጥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ፋሲካን ሊያደርግ ቢወድድ፥ አስቀድሞ ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ ይቅረብ ያድርግም፤ እንደ አገር ልጅም ይሆናል፤ ያልተገረዘ ሁሉ ግን ከእርሱ አይብላ።

verses.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to YAHUAH, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
verses.am: ለአገር ልጅ በእናንተ መካከልም ለሚቀመጡ እንግዶች አንድ ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Thus did all the children of Yisra'el; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh and Aaron, so did they.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that YAHUAH did bring the children of Yisra'el out of the land of Mitsrayim by their armies.
And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገርው።

verses.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Yisra'el, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ከሰውም ከእንስሳም ማሕፀንን የሚከፈት በኵር ሁሉ ለእኔ ቀድስልኝ፤ የእኔ ነው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Mitsrayim, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand YAHUAH brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን አለ። ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ የወጣችሁበትን ይህን ቀን አስቡ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከዚህ ቦታ በብርቱ እጅ አውጥቶአችኋልና፤ ስለዚህ የቦካ እንጀራ አትብሉ።

verses.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
verses.am: እናንተ ዛሬ በአቢብ ወር ወጥታችኋል።

verses.en: And it shall be when YAHUAH shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ ይሰጣት ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ ወደ ማለላቸው፥ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር፥ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ ይህችን አምልኮ በዚህ ወር ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፥ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር በዓል ይሆናል።

verses.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀንም ሙሉ ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፥ በአንተም ዘንድ እርሾ ያለበት እንጀራ አይታይ፥ በድንበርህም ሁሉ እርሾ አይታይ።

verses.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which YAHUAH did unto me when I came forth out of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን። ከግብፅ በወጣሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ስላደረገልኝ ነው ስትል ለልጅህ ትነግረዋለህ።

verses.en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that YAHUAH's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath YAHUAH brought thee out of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ አውጥቶሃልና የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በአፍህ ይሆን ዘንድ በእጅህ እንደ ምልክት በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደ መታሰቢያ ይሁንልህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
verses.am: በዓመት በዓመት በወራቱ ይህችን ሥርዓት ጠብቃት።

verses.en: And it shall be when YAHUAH shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ ለአባቶችህም እንደ ማለ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፥ እርስዋንም በሰጠህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That thou shalt set apart unto YAHUAH all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be YAHUAH's.
verses.am: ማሕፀንን የሚከፍተውን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ለይ፤ ከሚሆንልህ ከብት ሁሉ ተባት ሆኖ አስቀድሞ የተወለደው ለእግዚአብሔር ይሆናል።

verses.en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
verses.am: የአህያውን በኵር በጠቦት ትዋጀዋለህ፥ ባትዋጀውም አንገቱን ትሰብረዋለህ፤ የሰውንም በኵር ሁሉ ከልጆችህ መካከል ትዋጀዋለህ።

verses.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand YAHUAH brought us out from Mitsrayim, from the house of bondage:
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሚመጣው ጊዜ ልጅህ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ እንዲህ ትለዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጅ ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣን፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that YAHUAH slew all the firstborn in the land of Mitsrayim, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to YAHUAH all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም እንዳይሰድደን ልቡን ባጸና ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው በኵር ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ በኵር ድረስ በግብፅ ምድር ያለውን በኵር ሁሉ ገደለ፤ ስለዚህ ወንድ ሆኖ ማሕፀንን የከፈተውን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እሠዋለሁ፥ ነገር ግን የልጆቼን በኵር ሁሉ እዋጃለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand YAHUAH brought us forth out of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ አውጥቶናልና በእጅህ እንደ ምልክት፥ በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደ ተንጠለጠለ ነገር ይሁንልህ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that YAHUAH led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for YAHUAH said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Mitsrayim:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ፈርዖን ሕዝቡን በለቀቀ ጊዜ፥ ምንም ቅርብ ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር በፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር መንገድ አልመራቸውም፤ እግዚአብሔር። ሕዝቡ ሰልፉን ባየ ጊዜ እንዳይጸጽተው ወደ ግብፅም እንዳይመለስ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: But YAHUAH led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Yisra'el went up harnessed out of the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በዙሪያ መንገድ በኤርትራ ባሕር ባለችው ምድረ በዳ መራቸው። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ተሰልፈው ወጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took the bones of Yoseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yisra'el, saying, YAHUAH will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም። እግዚአብሔር ሳይጎበኛችሁ አይቀርም፥ አጥንቶቼንም ከዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር ታወጣላችሁ ብሎ የእስራኤልን ልጆች አምሎአቸው ነበርና ሙሴ የእርሱን አጥንቶች ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ።

verses.en: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.am: ከሱኮትም ተጓዙ፥ በምድረ በዳውም ዳር በኤታም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.am: በቀንና በሌሊትም ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገድ ሊያሳያቸው ቀን በደመና ዓምድ፥ ሊያበራላቸውም ሌሊት በእሳት ዓምድ እግዚአብሔር በፊታቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
verses.am: የደመና ዓምድ በቀን፥ የእሳት ዓምድ በሌሊት ከሕዝቡ ፊት ከቶ ፈቀቅ አላለም።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
verses.am: ተመልሰው በሚግዶልና በባሕር መካከል፥ በበኣልዛፎንም ፊት ለፊት ባለው በፊሀሒሮት ፊት እንዲሰፍሩ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ ከእርሱም አጠገብ በባሕር ዳር ትሰፍራላችሁ።

verses.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Yisra'el, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች። በምድር ይቅበዘበዛሉ፥ ምድረ በዳም ዘጋቻቸው ይላል።

verses.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Mitsrim may know that I am YAHUAH. And they did so.
verses.am: እኔም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ እርሱም ያባርራቸዋል፤ በፈርዖንና በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ላይ ክብር አገኛለሁ፤ ግብፃውያንም እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ። እነርሱም እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And it was told the king of Mitsrayim that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Yisra'el go from serving us?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም እንደ ኰበለሉ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ነገሩት፤ የፈርዖንና የባሪያዎቹም ልብ በሕዝቡ ላይ ተለወጠና። እንዳይገዛልን እስራኤልን የለቀቅነው ምን አድርገናል? አሉ።

verses.en: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.am: ሰረገላውንም አሰናዳ፥ ሕዝቡንም ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፤

verses.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Mitsrayim, and captains over every one of them.
verses.am: ስድስት መቶ የተመረጡ ሰረገሎችንም፥ የግብፅንም ፈረሶች ሁሉ፥ በእያንዳንዱም ሰረገላ ሁሉ ላይ ሦስተኞችን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Mitsrayim, and he pursued after the children of Yisra'el: and the children of Yisra'el went out with an high hand.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የግብፅን ንጉሥ የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ እርሱም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሳደደ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከፍ ባለች እጅ ወጡ።

verses.en: But the Mitsrim pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም የፈርዖን ፈረሶች ሰረገሎቹም ፈረሰኞቹም ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ፥ አሳደዱአቸው፤ በባሕሩ ዳር በበኣልዛፎን ፊት ለፊት ባለው በፊሀሒሮት አጠገብ ሰፍረው አገኙአቸው።

verses.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Yisra'el lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Mitsrim marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Yisra'el cried out unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም በቀረበ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ዓይናቸውን አነሡ፥ እነሆም ግብፃውያን በኋላቸው ገሥግስው ነበር፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እጅግ ፈሩ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ።

verses.en: And they said unto Mosheh, Because there were no graves in Mitsrayim, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Mitsrayim?
verses.am: ሙሴንም። በግብፅ መቃብር ስላልኖረ በምድረ በዳ እንሞት ዘንድ አወጣኸንን? ከግብፅ ታወጣን ዘንድ ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Mitsrayim, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Mitsrim? For it had been better for us to serve the Mitsrim, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ከምንሞት ብንገዛላቸው ይሻላልና። ተወን፥ ለግብፃውያን እንገዛ ብለን በግብፅ ሳለን ያልንህ ቃል ይህ አይደለምን? አሉት።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of YAHUAH, which he will shew to you to day: for the Mitsrim whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለሕዝቡ። አትፍሩ፥ ዛሬ የምታዩአቸውን ግብፃውያንን ለዘላለም አታዩአቸውምና ቁሙ፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የሚያደርጋትን የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን እዩ።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋል፥ እናንተም ዝም ትላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Yisra'el, that they go forward:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ለምን ትጮኽብኛለህ? እንዲጓዙ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገር።

verses.en: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Yisra'el shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.am: አንተም በትርህን አንሣ፥ እጅህንም በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ክፈለውም፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በባሕሩ ውስጥ በየብስ ያልፋሉ።

verses.en: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Mitsrim, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.am: እነሆም እኔ የግብፃውያንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ በኋላቸውም ይገባሉ፤ በፈርዖንና በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ በሰረገሎቹም በፈረሰኞቹም ላይ ክብር አገኛለሁ።

verses.en: And the Mitsrim shall know that I am YAHUAH, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም በፈርዖንና በሰረገሎቹ በፈረሰኞቹም ላይ ክብር ባገኘሁ ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And the angel of YAHUAH, which went before the camp of Yisra'el, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ሠራዊት ፊት ይሄድ የነበረው የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ፈቀቅ ብሎ በኋላቸው ሄደ፤ የደመናውም ዓምድ ከፊታቸው ፈቀቅ ብሎ በኋላቸው ቆመ፥

verses.en: And it came between the camp of the Mitsrim and the camp of Yisra'el; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
verses.am: በግብፃውያን ሰፈርና በእስራኤል ሰፈር መካከልም ገባ፤ በዚያም ደመናና ጨለማ ነበረ፥ በዚህ በኩል ግን ሌሊቱን አበራ፤ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ እርስ በእርሳቸው አልተቃረቡም።

verses.en: And Mosheh stretched out his hand over the sea; and YAHUAH caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.am: ሙሴም በባሕሩ ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ጽኑ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ አምጥቶ ባሕሩን አስወገደው፥ ባሕሩንም አደረቀው፥ ውኃውም ተከፈለ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በባሕሩ መካከል በየብስ ገቡ፤ ውኃውም በቀኛቸውና በግራቸው እንደ ግድግዳ ሆነላቸው።

verses.en: And the Mitsrim pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.am: ግብፃውያንም፥ የፈርዖን ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎች ፈረሰኞቹም ሁሉ፥ እያሳደዱ በኋላቸው ወደ ባሕር መካከል ገቡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch YAHUAH looked unto the host of the Mitsrim through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Mitsrim,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ውኃውም በግብፃውያን በሰረገሎቻቸውም በፈረሰኞቻቸውም ላይ ይመለስ አለው።

verses.en: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Mitsrim said, Let us flee from the face of Yisra'el; for YAHUAH fighteth for them against the Mitsrim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ውኃውም በግብፃውያን በሰረገሎቻቸውም በፈረሰኞቻቸውም ላይ ይመለስ አለው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Mitsrim, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጁን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘረጋ፥ ባሕሩም ማለዳ ወደ መፍሰሱ ተመለሰ፤ ግብፃውያንም ከእርሱ ሸሹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ግብፃውያንን በባሕሩ መካከል ጣላቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Mitsrim fled against it; and YAHUAH overthrew the Mitsrim in the midst of the sea.
verses.am: ውኃውም ተመልሶ በኋላቸው ወደ ባሕር የገቡትን ሰረገሎችን ፈረሰኞችንም የፈርዖንንም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከደነ፤ ከእነርሱም አንድ ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.en: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን በባሕሩ ውስጥ በየብስ ሄዱ፤ ውኆችም በቀኛቸውና በግራቸው እንደ ግድግዳ ሆኑላችው።

verses.en: But the children of Yisra'el walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዚያን ቀን እስራኤልን እንደዚህ ከግብፃውያን እጅ አዳነ፤ እስራኤልም የግብፃውያንን ሬሳ በባሕር ዳር አዩ።

verses.en: Thus YAHUAH saved Yisra'el that day out of the hand of the Mitsrim; and Yisra'el saw the Mitsrim dead upon the sea shore.
verses.am: እስራኤልም እግዚአብሔር በግብፃውያን ላይ ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን እጅ አዩ፥ ሕዝቡም እግዚአብሔርን ፈሩ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም በባሪያውም በሙሴ አመኑ።

verses.en: And Yisra'el saw that great work which YAHUAH did upon the Mitsrim: and the people feared YAHUAH, and believed YAHUAH, and his servant Mosheh.
Then sang Mosheh and the children of Yisra'el this song unto YAHUAH, and spake, saying, I will sing unto YAHUAH, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ሙሴና የእስራኤል ልጆች ይህንን መዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘመሩ፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩ። በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ለእግዚአብሔር እዘምራለሁ፤ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን በባሕር ጣለ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my YAHUAH, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's YAHUAH, and I will exalt him.
verses.am: ጕልበቴ ዝማሬዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥  መድኃኒቴም ሆነልኝ፤  ይህ አምላኬ ነው አመሰግነውማለሁ፥ የአባቴ አምላክ ነው ከፍ ከፍም አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH is a man of war: YAHUAH is his name.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ተዋጊ ነው፥ ስሙም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
verses.am: የፈርዖንን ሰረገሎች ሠራዊቱንም በባሕር ጣላቸው፤  የተመረጡት ሦስተኞች በኤርትራ ባሕር ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
verses.am: ቀላያትም ከደኑአቸው፤  ወደ ባሕር ጥልቀት እንደ ድንጋይ ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: Thy right hand, O YAHUAH, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O YAHUAH, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቀኝህ በኃይል ከበረ፤  አቤቱ፥ ቀኝህ ጠላቱን አደቀቀ።

verses.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
verses.am: በክብርህም ብዛት የተነሡብህን አጠፋህ፤  ቍጣህን ሰድደህ፥ እንደ ገለባም በላቸው።

verses.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.am: በአፍንጫህ እስትንፋስ ውኆች ተከመሩ፥  ፈሳሾቹም እንደ ክምር ቆሙ፤  ሞገዱም በባሕር ውስጥ ረጋ።

verses.en: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.am: ጠላትም። አሳድጄ እይዛቸዋለሁ፥  ምርኮም እካፈላለሁ፥ ነፍሴም ትጠግባቸዋለች፤ ሰይፌንም እመዝዛለሁ፥ እጄም ታጠፋቸዋለች አለ።

verses.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.am: ነፋስህን አነፈስህ፥ ባሕርም ከደናቸው፤  በኃይለኞች ውኆችም እንደ አረር ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: Who is like unto thee, O YAHUAH, among the elohim? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአማልክት መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?  በምስጋና የተፈራህ፥ ድንቅንም የምታደርግ፥  በቅድስና የከበረ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
verses.am: ቀኝህን ዘረጋህ፥ ምድርም ዋጠቻቸው።

verses.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verses.am: በቸርነትህ የተቤዠሃቸውን ሕዝብህን መራህ፤  በኃይልህ ወደ ቅዱስ ማደሪያህ አገባሃቸው።

verses.en: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሰሙ፥ ተንቀጠቀጡም፤  በፍልስጥኤም የሚኖሩትን ምጥ ያዛቸው።

verses.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ የኤዶም አለቆች ደነገጡ፤ የሞአብን ኃያላን መንቀጥቀጥ ያዛቸው፤ በከነዓን የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ቀለጡ።

verses.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O YAHUAH, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብህ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ የተቤዠኸው ሕዝብ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ፍርሃትና ድንጋጤ ወደቀባቸው፤ በክንድህ ብርታት እንደ ድንጋይ ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O YAHUAH, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O YAHUAH, which thy hands have established.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ታስገባቸዋለህ፥ በርስትህ ተራራም ትተክላቸዋለህ፥ አቤቱ፥ ለማደሪያህ ባደረግኸው ስፍራ፥ አቤቱ፥ እጆችህ ባዘጋጁት መቅደስ።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለሙ እስከ ፍጻሜ ይነግሣል።

verses.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and YAHUAH brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Yisra'el went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
verses.am: የፈርዖን ፈረሶች ከሰረገሎቹ ከፈረሰኞቹም ጋር ወደ ባሕር ገቡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የባሕሩን ውኆች መለሰባቸው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን በባሕሩ መካከል በየብስ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.am: የአሮን እኅት ነቢይቱ ማሪያምም ከበሮ በእጅዋ ወሰደች፤ ሴቶችም ሁሉ በከበሮና በዘፈን በኋላዋ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to YAHUAH, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.am: ማርያምም እየዘመረች መለሰችላቸው። በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፤ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን በባሕር ጣለ።

verses.en: So Mosheh brought Yisra'el from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.am: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ከኤርትራ ባሕር አስጓዘ፥ ወደ ሱርም ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ በምድረ በዳም ሦስት ቀን ሄዱ፥ ውኃም አላገኙም።

verses.en: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.am: ወደ ማራም በመጡ ጊዜ የማራ ውኃ መራራ ነበረና ሊጠጡ አልቻሉም፤ ስለዚህ የዚያ ስፍራ ስም ማራ ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And the people murmured against Mosheh, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። ምን እንጠጣለን? ብለው በሙሴ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And he cried unto YAHUAH; and YAHUAH shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንጨትን አሳየው፥ በውኃውም ላይ ጣለው፥ ውኃውም ጣፈጠ። በዚያም ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን አደረገላቸው፥ በዚያም ፈተናቸው፤

verses.en: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Mitsrim: for I am YAHUAH that healeth thee.
verses.am: እርሱም። አንተ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አጥብቀህ ብትሰማ፥ በፊቱም የሚበጀውን ብታደርግ፥ ትእዛዙንም ብታደምጥ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ በግብፃውያን ላይ ያመጣሁትን በሽታ አላደርስብህም፤ እኔ ፈዋሽህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና አለ።

verses.en: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ኤሊም መጡ፥ በዚያም አሥራ ሁለት የውኃ ምንጮችና ሰባ የዘንባባ ዛፎች ነበሩባት፤ በዚያም በውኃው አጠገብ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ከኤሊምም ተጓዙ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ከግብፅ አገር ከወጡ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በኤሊምና በሲና መካከል ወዳለችው ወደ ሲን ምድረ በዳ መጡ።

verses.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Yisra'el murmured against Mosheh and Aaron in the wilderness:
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በምድረ በዳ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el said unto them, Would to YAHUAH we had died by the hand of YAHUAH in the land of Mitsrayim, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። ይህን ጉባኤ ሁሉ በራብ ልትገድሉ እኛን ወደዚች ምድረ በዳ አውጥታችኋል፤ በሥጋው ምንቸት አጠገብ ተቀምጠን እንጀራ ስንበላ ስንጠግብ ሳለን በግብፅ ምድር በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ምነው በሞትን! አሉአቸው።

verses.en: Then said YAHUAH unto Mosheh, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በሕጌ ይሄዱ ወይም አይሄዱ እንደሆነ እኔ እንድፈትናቸው፥ እነሆ ከሰማይ እንጀራን አዘንብላችኋለሁ፤ ሕዝቡም ወጥተው ለዕለት ለዕለት የሚበቃቸውን ይልቀሙ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በስድስተኛው ቀን ያመጡትን ያዘጋጁ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም ከሚለቅሙት ይልቅ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሁን አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Aaron said unto all the children of Yisra'el, At even, then ye shall know that YAHUAH hath brought you out from the land of Mitsrayim:
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ ምድር እንዳወጣችሁ ማታ ታውቃላችሁ፥

verses.en: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of YAHUAH; for that he heareth your murmurings against YAHUAH: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ክብር ጥዋት ታያላችሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ያንጐራጐራችሁትን ሰምቶአልና በእኛም ላይ የምታንጐራጕሩ እኛ ምንድር ነን? አሉ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, This shall be, when YAHUAH shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that YAHUAH heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ያንጐራጐራችሁበትን ማንጐራጐራችሁን ሰምቶአልና በመሸ ጊዜ ትበሉ ዘንድ ሥጋን፥ ማልዶም ትጠግቡ ዘንድ እንጀራን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣችኋል፤ እኛም ምንድር ነን? ማንጐራጐራችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ነው እንጂ በእኛ አይደለም አለ።

verses.en: And Mosheh spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el, Come near before YAHUAH: for he hath heard your murmurings.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። ማንጐራጐራችሁን ሰምቶአልና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅረቡ በል አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Yisra'el, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of YAHUAH appeared in the cloud.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አሮን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በተናገረ ጊዜ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፊታቸውን አቀኑ፤ እነሆም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በደመናው ታየ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመሸ ጊዜ ድርጭቶች መጡ፥ ሰፈሩንም ከደኑት፤ ማለዳም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ጠል ወድቆ ነበር።

verses.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yisra'el: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am YAHUAH your YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመሸ ጊዜ ድርጭቶች መጡ፥ ሰፈሩንም ከደኑት፤ ማለዳም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ጠል ወድቆ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
verses.am: የወደቀውም ጠል ባለፈ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ በመሬት ላይ እንደ ደቃቅ ውርጭ ሆኖ ቅርፊት የሚመስል ደቃቅ ነገር በምድረ በዳ ታየ።

verses.en: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ባዩት ጊዜ ያ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላወቁምና እርስ በእርሳቸው። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ተባባሉ። ሙሴም። ትበሉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር የሰጣችሁ እንጀራ ነው።

verses.en: And when the children of Yisra'el saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Mosheh said unto them, This is the bread which YAHUAH hath given you to eat.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው። እያንዳንዱ የሚበላውን ያህል ይልቀም፤ በድኳኑ ባሉት ነፍሶች ቍጥር ለአንድ ሰው አንድ ጎሞር ውሰዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: This is the thing which YAHUAH hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ አንዱ አብዝቶ አንዱም አሳንሶ ለቀመ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
verses.am: በጎሞርም በሰፈሩት ጊዜ እጅግ ለለቀመ አልተረፈውም ጥቂትም ለለቀመ አልጐደለበትም፤ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የሚበላውን ያህል ለቀመ።

verses.en: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ማንም ከእርሱ አንዳች ለነገ አያስቀር አላቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሙሴን አልሰሙትም፤ አንዳንድ ሰዎችም ከእርሱ ለነገ አስቀሩ፥ እርሱም ተላ ሸተተም፤ ሙሴም ተቈጣቸው።

verses.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Mosheh; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Mosheh was wroth with them.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ዕለት ዕለት የሚበላውን ያህል በጥዋት ለቀመ፤ ፀሐይም በተኰሰ ጊዜ ቀለጠ።

verses.en: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በስድስተኛው ቀን ሁለት እጥፍ አድርገው እያንዳንዳቸው ሁለት ጎሞር እንጀራ ለቀሙ፤ የማኀበሩም አለቆች ሁሉ መጥተው ለሙሴ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Mosheh.
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ይህ ነው። ነገ ዕረፍት፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የተቀደሰ ሰንበት ነው፤ የምትጋግሩትን ጋግሩ፥ የምትቀቅሉትንም ቀቅሉ፥ የተረፈውን ሁሉ ለነገ እንዲጠበቅ አኑሩት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, This is that which YAHUAH hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto YAHUAH: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘ ለነገ አኖሩት፤ አልሸተተም፥ ትልም አልሆነበትም።

verses.en: And they laid it up till the morning, as Mosheh bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
verses.am: ሙሴም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰንበት ዛሬ ነውና ብሉት፤ ዛሬ በሜዳ አታገኙትም።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto YAHUAH: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ልቀሙት፤ ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ሰንበት ነው፤ በእርሱ አይገኝም አለ።

verses.en: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከሕዝቡ አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሊለቅሙ ወጡ፥ ምንምን አላገኙም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ትእዛዞቼንና ሕጎቼን ለመጠበቅ እስከ መቼ እንቢ ትላላችሁ?

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰንበትን እንደ ሰጣችሁ እዩ፤ ስለዚህ በስድስተኛው ቀን የሁለት ቀን እንጀራ ሰጣችሁ፤ ሰው ሁሉ በስፍራው ይቀመጥ፥ በሰባተኛው ቀን ማንም ከስፍራው አይሂድ አለው።

verses.en: See, for that YAHUAH hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በሰባተኛው ቀን ዐረፈ።

verses.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ወገን ስሙን መና ብለው ጠሩት፤ እርሱም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነጭ ነው፤ ጣዕሙም እንደ ማር ቂጣ ነው።

verses.en: And the house of Yisra'el called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው። ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣኋችሁ ጊዜ በምድረ በዳ ያበላኋችሁን እንጀራ ያዩ ዘንድ ከእርሱ አንድ ጎሞር ሙሉ ለልጅ ልጆቻችሁ ይጠበቅ አለ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, This is the thing which YAHUAH commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። አንድ ማድጋ ወስደህ ጎሞር ሙሉ መና አግባበት፥ ለልጅ ልጃችሁም ይጠበቅ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አኑረው አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before YAHUAH, to be kept for your generations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ ይጠበቅ ዘንድ አሮን በምስክሩ ፊት አኖረው።

verses.en: As YAHUAH commanded Mosheh, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደሚኖሩባት ምድር እስኪመጡ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት መና በሉ፤ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ድንበር እስኪመጡ ድረስ መና በሉ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.am: ጎሞርም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል ነው።

verses.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

And all the congregation of the children of Yisra'el journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of YAHUAH, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ ከሲን ምድረ በዳ ሊጓዙ ተነሡ፥ በራፊዲምም ሰፈሩ፤ ሕዝቡም ይጠጡ ዘንድ ውኃ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Mosheh, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Mosheh said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt YAHUAH?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሙሴን ተጣሉት። የምንጠጣውን ውኃ ስጠን አሉት። ሙሴም። ለምን ትጣሉኛላችሁ? እግዚአብሔርንስ ለምን ትፈታተናላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Mosheh, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Mitsrayim, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በዚያ ስፍራ ውኃ ተጠሙ። እኛንና ልጆቻችንን ከብቶቻችንንም በጥማት ልትገድል ለምን ከግብፅ አወጣኸን? ሲሉ በሙሴ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And Mosheh cried unto YAHUAH, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ሊወግሩኝ ቀርበዋልና በዚህ ሕዝብ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Yisra'el; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በሕዝቡ ፊት እለፍ፥ ከእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤ ወንዙንም የመታህባትን በትር በእጅህ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.en: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Mosheh did so in the sight of the elders of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እነሆ እኔ በዚያ በኮሬብ በዓለት ላይ በፊትህ እቆማለሁ፤ ዓለቱንም ትመታለህ፥ ሕዝቡም ይጠጣ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ውኃ ይወጣል አለው። ሙሴም በእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ፊት እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Yisra'el, and because they tempted YAHUAH, saying, Is YAHUAH among us, or not?
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤልም ልጆች ክርክር። እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ነውን ወይስ አይደለም? ሲሉ እግዚአብሔርን ስለተፈታተኑት የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ማሳህ፥ ደግሞም መሪባ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Yisra'el in Rephidim.
verses.am: አማሌቅም መጥቶ ከእስራኤል ጋር በራፊድም ተዋጋ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Yahoshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of YAHUAH in mine hand.
verses.am: ሙሴም ኢያሱን። ጕልማሶችን ምረጥልን፥ ወጥተህም ከአማሌቅ ጋር ተዋጋ፤ እኔ ነገ የእግዚአብሔርን በትር በእጄ ይዤ በኮረብታው ራስ ላይ እቆማለሁ አለው።

verses.en: So Yahoshua did as Mosheh had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Mosheh, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ሙሴ እንዳለው አደረገ፥ ከአማሌቅም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ሙሴና አሮንም ሖርም ወደ ኮረብታው ራስ ወጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Mosheh held up his hand, that Yisra'el prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ እጁን ባነሣ ጊዜ እስራኤል ድል ያደርግ ነበር፤ እጁንም ባወረደ ጊዜ አማሌቅ ድል ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: But Mosheh' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.am: የሙሴ እጆች ግን ከብደው ነበር፤ ድንጋይም ወሰዱ፥ በበታቹም አኖሩ፥ እርሱም ተቀመጠበት፤ አሮንና ሖርም አንዱ በዚህ አንዱ በዚያ ሆነው እጆቹን ይደግፉ ነበር፤ ፀሐይም እስክትገባ ድረስ እጆቹ ጠነከሩ።

verses.en: And Yahoshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.am: ኢያሱም አማሌቅንና ሕዝቡን በሰይፍ ስለት አሸነፈ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Yahoshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአማሌቅን ዝክር ከሰማይ በታች ጨርሼ እደመስሳለሁና ይህን ለመታሰቢያ በመጽሐፍ ጻፈው፥ በኢያሱም ጆሮ ተናገር አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh built an altar, and called the name of it YAHUAH-Nissi:
verses.am: ሙሴም መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ ስሙንም ይህዌህ ንሲ ብሎ ጠራው፤

verses.en: For he said, Because YAHUAH hath sworn that YAHUAH will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.am: እርሱም። እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ላይ ስለጫነ የእግዚአብሔር ሰልፍ በአማሌቅ ላይ ለልጅ ልጅ ይሁን አለ።

verses.en: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Mosheh' father in law, heard of all that YAHUAH had done for Mosheh, and for Yisra'el his people, and that YAHUAH had brought Yisra'el out of Mitsrayim;
verses.am: የምድያምም ካህን የሙሴ አማት ዮቶር እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን ከግብፅ እንዳወጣ ሰማ።

verses.en: Then Jethro, Mosheh' father in law, took Zipporah, Mosheh' wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የሙሴ አማት ዮቶር መልሶአት የነበረውን የሙሴን ሚስት ሲፓራን ሁለቱንም ልጆቿን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
verses.am: ከእነርሱ የአንደኛው ስም ጌርሳም ነበረ፤ አባቱ። በሌላ አገር ስደተኛ ነበርሁ ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for YAHUAH of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
verses.am: የሁለተኛውም ስም አልዓዛር ነበረ። የአባቴ አምላክ ረዳኝ፥ ከፈርዖንም ሰይፍ አዳነኝ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: And Jethro, Mosheh' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Mosheh into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of YAHUAH:
verses.am: የሙሴ አማት ዮቶርም ከልጆቹና ከሚስቱ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ አጠገብ በምድረ በዳ ወደ ሰፈረ ወደ ሙሴ መጣ።

verses.en: And he said unto Mosheh, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.am: ሙሴንም። እኔ አማትህ ዮቶር፥ ሚስትህም፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ሁለቱ ልጆችዋ መጥተንልሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.am: ሙሴም አማቱን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ሰገደም፥ ሳመውም፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም ደኅንነታቸውን ተጠያየቁ፥ ወደ ድንኳኑም ገቡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh told his father in law all that YAHUAH had done unto Pharaoh and to the Mitsrim for Yisra'el's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how YAHUAH delivered them.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር በፈርዖንና በግብፃውያን ላይ ስለ እስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥ በመንገድም ያገኛቸውን ድካም ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዳናቸው ለአማቱ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which YAHUAH had done to Yisra'el, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Mitsrim.
verses.am: ዮቶርም እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ሁሉ፥ ከግብፃውያንም እጅ ስላዳናቸው ደስ አለው።

verses.en: And Jethro said, Blessed be YAHUAH, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Mitsrim, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Mitsrim.
verses.am: ዮቶርም። ከግብፃውያንና ከፈርዖን እጅ ያዳናችሁ፥ ከግብፃውያንም እጅ ሕዝቡን ያዳነ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.en: Now I know that YAHUAH is greater than all elohim: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
verses.am: ትዕቢት ባደረጉባቸው ነገር እግዚአብሔር ከአማልክት ሁሉ እንዲበልጥ አሁን አወቅሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Jethro, Mosheh' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for YAHUAH: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Yisra'el, to eat bread with Mosheh' father in law before YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሙሴ አማት ዮቶርም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንና ሌላ መሥዋዕትን ለእግዚአብሔር ወሰደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ከሙሴ አማት ጋር እንጀራ ሊበሉ አሮን የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Mosheh sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Mosheh from the morning unto the evening.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ሙሴ በሕዝቡ ሊፈርድ ተቀመጠ፤ ሕዝቡም በሙሴ ፊት ከጥዋት እስከ ማታ ድረስ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And when Mosheh' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
verses.am: የሙሴም አማት በሕዝቡ ያደረገውን ሁሉ ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ በሕዝቡ የምታደርገው ምንድር ነው? ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ከጥዋት ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ በዙሪያህ ቆመው ሳሉ አንተ ብቻህን ስለ ምን ተቀምጠሃል? አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of YAHUAH:
verses.am: ሙሴም አማቱን። ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ወደ እኔ ይመጣሉ፤

verses.en: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of YAHUAH, and his laws.
verses.am: ነገርም ቢኖራቸው ወደ እኔ ይመጣሉ፥ በዚህና በዚያ ሰውም መካከል እፈርዳለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥርዓትና ሕግ አስታውቃቸዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
verses.am: የሙሴም አማት አለው። አንተ የምታደርገው ይህ ነገር መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.am: ይህ ነገር ይከብድብሃልና አንተ ከአንተም ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ ትደክማላችሁ፤ አንተ ብቻህን ልታደርገው አትችልም።

verses.en: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and YAHUAH shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to YAHUAH-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto YAHUAH:
verses.am: አሁንም እመክርሃለሁና ቃሌን ስማ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፤ አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለሕዝቡ ሁን፥ ነገራቸውንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አድርስ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.am: ሥርዓቱንም ሕጉንም አስተምራቸው፥ የሚሄዱበትን መንገድ የሚያደርጉትንም ሥራ ሁሉ አሳያቸው።

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear YAHUAH, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.am: አንተም ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ አዋቂዎችን፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩትን፥ የታመኑ፥ የግፍንም ረብ የሚጠሉትን ሰዎች ምረጥ፤ ከእነርሱም የሺህ አለቆችን፥ የመቶ አለቆችን፥ የአምሳ አለቆችን፥ የአሥርም አለቆችን ሹምላቸው።

verses.en: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
verses.am: በሕዝቡ ላይ ሁልጊዜ ይፍረዱ፤ አውራውን ነገር ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ያምጡት፥ ታናሹንም ነገር ሁሉ እነርሱ ይፍረዱ፤ እነርሱም ከአንተ ጋር ሸክሙን ይሸከማሉ፥ ለአንተም ይቀልልልሃል።

verses.en: If thou shalt do this thing, and YAHUAH command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
verses.am: ይህንም ብታደርግ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ ቢያዝዝህ፥ መቆም ይቻልሃል፥ ደግሞም ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በሰላም ወደ ስፍራው ይደርሳል።

verses.en: So Mosheh hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
verses.am: ሙሴም የአማቱን ቃል ሰማ፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Mosheh chose able men out of all Yisra'el, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ አዋቂዎችን መረጠ፥ በሕዝቡም ላይ የሺህ አለቆች፥ የመቶም አለቆች፥ የአምሳም አለቆች፥ የአሥርም አለቆች አድርጎ ሾማቸው።

verses.en: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Mosheh, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም ላይ ሁልጊዜ ፈረዱ፤ የከበደባቸውንም ነገር ወደ ሙሴ አመጡ፥ ታናሹን ነገር ሁሉ ግን እነርሱ ፈረዱ።

verses.en: And Mosheh let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.am: ሙሴም አማቱን ሰደደው፤ እርሱም ወደ አገሩ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: In the third month, when the children of Yisra'el were gone forth out of the land of Mitsrayim, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ወር የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በዚያ ቀን ወደ ሲና ምድረ በዳ መጡ።

verses.en: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Yisra'el camped before the mount.
verses.am: ከራፊድም ተነሥተው ወደ ሲና ምድረ በዳ መጡ፥ በምድረ በዳም ሰፈሩ፤ በዚያም እስራኤል በተራራው ፊት ሰፈረ።

verses.en: And Mosheh went up unto YAHUAH, and YAHUAH called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Ya'aqob, and tell the children of Yisra'el;
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በተራራው ጠርቶ አለው። ለያዕቆብ ቤት እንዲህ በል፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ንገር።

verses.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Mitsrim, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.am: በግብፃውያን ያደረግሁትን፥ በንስርም ክንፍ እንደተሸከምኋችሁ፥ ወደ እኔም እንዳመጣኋችሁ አይታችኋል።

verses.en: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.am: አሁንም ቃሌን በእውነት ብትሰሙ ኪዳኔንም ብትጠብቁ፥ ምድር ሁሉ የእኔ ናትና ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተመረጠ ርስት ትሆኑልኛላችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እናንተም የካህናት መንግሥት የተቀደሰም ሕዝብ ትሆኑልኛላችሁ። ለእስራኤል ልጆች የምትነግራቸው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And Mosheh came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which YAHUAH commanded him.
verses.am: ሙሴም መጣ፥ የሕዝቡንም ሽማግሌዎች ጠርቶ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በፊታቸው ተናገረ።

verses.en: And all the people answered together, and said, All that YAHUAH hath spoken we will do. And Mosheh returned the words of the people unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ሁሉ አንድ አፍ ሆነው። እግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ብለው መለሱ፤ ሙሴም የሕዝቡን ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር አደረሰ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Mosheh told the words of the people unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ከአንተ ጋር ስነጋገር ሕዝቡ እንዲሰሙ፥ ደግሞም ለዘላለም እንዲያምኑብህ፥ እነሆ በከባድ ደመና እመጣልሃለሁ አለው። ሙሴም የሕዝቡን ቃል ለእግዚአብሔር ነገረ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ሕዝቡ ሂድ፥ ዛሬና ነገም ቀድሳቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም ይጠቡ፤

verses.en: And be ready against the third day: for the third day YAHUAH will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.am: በሦስተኛው ቀን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲያዩ እግዚአብሔር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ይወርዳልና ለሦስተኛው ቀን ይዘጋጁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.am: ወሰንም ለሕዝቡ በዙሪያው አድርግላቸው። ወደ ተራራው እንዳትወጡ ጫፉንም እንዳትነኩ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ተራራውንም የነካ ፈጽሞ ይሞታል፤

verses.en: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.am: የማንም እጅ አይንካ፤ ነገር ግን የሚነካው ሁሉ ይወገራል፥ ወይም በፍላጻ ይወጋል፤ እንስሳ ወይም ሰው ቢሆን አይድንም በላቸው። ሳያቋርጥ የመለከት ድምፅ ሲነፋ በዚያን ጊዜ ወደ ተራራው ይውጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከተራራው ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረደ፥ ሕዝቡንም ቀደሰ፤ ልብሳቸውንም አጠቡ።

verses.en: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም። ለሦስተኛው ቀን ተዘጋጁ፥ ወደ ሴቶቻችሁ አትቅረቡ አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሦስተኛው ቀን በማለዳ ጊዜ ነጐድጓድና መብረቅ ከባድም ደመና እጅግም የበረታ የቀንደ መለከት ድምጽ በተራራው ላይ ሆነ፤ በሰፈሩም የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with YAHUAH; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ለማገናኘት ከሰፈር አወጣቸው፤ ከተራራውም እግርጌ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because YAHUAH descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእሳት ስለ ወረደበት የሲና ተራራ ሁሉ ይጤስ ነበር፤ ከእርሱም እንደ እቶን ጢስ ያለ ጢስ ይወጣ ነበር፥ ተራራውም ሁሉ እጅግ ይናወጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Mosheh spake, and YAHUAH answered him by a voice.
verses.am: የቀንደ መለከቱም ድምፅ እጅግ በበረታና በጸና ጊዜ ሙሴ ተናገረ እግዚአብሔርም በድምፅ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And YAHUAH came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and YAHUAH called Mosheh up to the top of the mount; and Mosheh went up.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሲና ተራራ ላይ ወደ ተራራው ራስ ወረደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ጠራው፤ ሙሴም ወጣ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto YAHUAH to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ውረድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ለማየት ዳርቻውን እንዳያልፉ ከእነርሱም ብዙ እንዳይጠፉ ለሕዝቡ አስጠንቅቃቸው፤

verses.en: And let the priests also, which come near to YAHUAH, sanctify themselves, lest YAHUAH break forth upon them.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የሚቀርቡት ካህናት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋቸው ራሳቸውን ይቀድሱ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto YAHUAH, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ። በተራራው ዙሪያ ወሰን አድርግ ቀድሰውም ብለህ አስጠንቅቀኸናልና ሕዝቡ ወደ ተራራ ይወጡ ዘንድ አይችሉም አለው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto YAHUAH, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሂድ፥ ውረድ፤ አንተ አሮንም ከአንተ ጋር ትወጣላችሁ፤ ካህናቱና ሕዝቡ ግን እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይወጡ ዘንድ አይተላለፉ አለው።

verses.en: So Mosheh went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረደ፥ ይህንንም ነገራቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake all these words, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: I am YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, which have brought thee out of the land of Mitsrayim, out of the house of bondage.
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt have no other elohim before me.
verses.am: ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።  ፕ

verses.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.am: በላይ በሰማይ ካለው፥ በታችም በምድር ካለው፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ካለው ነገር የማናቸውንም ምሳሌ፥ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ለአንተ አታድርግ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I YAHUAH thy YAHUAH am a jealous YAHUAH, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.am: አትስገድላቸው፥ አታምልካቸውምም፤ በሚጠሉኝ እስከ ሦስተኛና እስከ አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ የአባቶችን ኃጢአት በልጆች ላይ የማመጣ፤

verses.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.am: ለሚወድዱኝ፥ ትእዛዜንም ለሚጠብቁ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ድረስ ምሕረትን የማደርግ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ቀናተኛ አምላክ ነኝና። ፕ

verses.en: Thou shalt not take the name of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH in vain; for YAHUAH will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክህን ስም በከንቱ አትጥራ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስሙን በከንቱ የሚጠራውን ከበደል አያነጻውምና።

verses.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.am: የሰንበትን ቀን ትቀድሰው ዘንድ አስብ።

verses.en: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ተግባርህንም ሁሉ አድርግ፤

verses.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.am: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላክህ ሰንበት ነው፤ አንተ፥ ወንድ ልጅህም፥ ሴት ልጅህም፥ ሎሌህም፥ ገረድህም፥ ከብትህም፥ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ያለ እንግዳ በእርሱ ምንም ሥራ አትሥሩ፤

verses.en: For in six days YAHUAH made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore YAHUAH blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በስድስት ቀን ሰማይንና ምድርን፥ ባሕርንም፥ ያለባቸውንም ሁሉ ፈጥሮ በሰባተኛው ቀን ዐርፎአልና፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር የሰንበትን ቀን ባርኮታል ቀድሶታልም።

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which YAHUAH thy YAHUAH giveth thee.
verses.am: አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም።

verses.en: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.am: አትግደል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.am: አታመንዝር።

verses.en: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.am: አትስረቅ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.am: በባልንጀራህ ላይ በሐሰት አትመስክር።

verses.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.am: የባልንጀራህን ቤት አትመኝ፤ የባልንጀራህን ሚስት ሎሌውንም ገረዱንም በሬውንም አህያውንም ከባልንጀራህ ገንዘብ ሁሉ ማናቸውንም አትመኝ።

verses.en: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ነጐድጓዱንና መብረቁን፥ የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ፥ ተራራውንም ሲጤስ አዩ፤ ሕዝቡም ባዩ ጊዜ ተርበደበዱ፥ ርቀውም ቆሙ።

verses.en: And they said unto Mosheh, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not YAHUAH speak with us, lest we die.
verses.am: ሙሴንም። አንተ ተናገረን እኛም እንሰማለን፤ እንዳንሞት ግን እግዚአብሔር አይናገረን አሉት።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto the people, Fear not: for YAHUAH is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለሕዝቡ። እግዚአብሔር ሊፈትናችሁ፥ ኃጢያትንም እንዳትሠሩ እርሱን መፍራት በልባችሁ ይሆን ዘንድ መጥቶአልና አትፍሩ አለ።

verses.en: And the people stood afar off, and Mosheh drew near unto the thick darkness where YAHUAH was.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ርቀው ቆሙ፥ ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር ወዳለበት ወደ ጨለማው ቀረበ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Yisra'el, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን አለው። ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በል። እኔ ከሰማይ እንደ ተናገርኋችሁ እናንተ አይታችኋል።

verses.en: Ye shall not make with me elohim of silver, neither shall ye make unto you elohim of gold.
verses.am: በአጠገቤ ምንም አታድርጉ፤ የብር አማልክት የወርቅም አማልክት ለእናንተ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.am: የጭቃ መሠዊያ ሥራልኝ፥ የሚቃጠለውንና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕትህን በጎችህንም በሬዎችህንም ሠዋበት፤ ስሜን በማሳስብበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ወደ አንተ መጥቼ እባርክሃለሁ።

verses.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.am: የድንጋይም መሠዊያ ብታደርግልኝ ብረት በነካው ድንጋይ አትሥራው፤ በመሣሪያ ብትነካው ታረክሰዋለህና።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.am: ኃፍረተ ሥጋህ በእርሱ እንዳይገለጥ ወደ መሠዊያዬ በደረጃ አትውጣ።

verses.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.am: በፊታቸው የምታደርገው ሥርዓት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: If thou buy an Ibri servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.am: ዕብራዊ ባሪያ የገዛህ እንደሆነ ስድስት ዓመት ያገልግልህ፥ በሰባተኛውም በከንቱ አርነት ይውጣ።

verses.en: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.am: ብቻውን መጥቶ እንደሆነ ብቻውን ይውጣ፤ ከሚስቱ ጋር መጥቶ እንደሆነ ሚስቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ትውጣ።

verses.en: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.am: ጌታው ሚስት አጋብቶት እንደ ሆነ ወንዶች ወይም ሴቶች ልጆች ብትወልድለት፥ ሚስቱና ልጆችዋ ለጌታው ይሁኑ፥ እርሱም ብቻውን ይውጣ።

verses.en: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.am: ባሪያውም። ጌታዬን ሚስቴን ልጅቼንም እወድዳለሁ፥ አርነት አልወጣም ብሎ ቢናገር፥ ጌታው ወደ ፈራጆች ይውሰደው፥

verses.en: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.am: ወደ ደጁም ወደ መቃኑ አቅርቦ ጆሮውን በወስፌ ይብሳው፤ ለዘላለምም ባሪያው ይሁን።

verses.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.am: ሰውም ሴት ልጁን ለባርነት ቢሸጥ ባሪያዎች እንደሚወጡ እርስዋ አትውጣ።

verses.en: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.am: ጌታዋን ደስ ባታሰኘው በዎጆ ይስደዳት፤ ስለ ናቃት ለሌላ ወገን ሰዎች ይሸጣት ዘንድ አይገባውም።

verses.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.am: ለልጁም ብድራት፥ ለሴት ልጆች የሚገባውን ያድርግላት።

verses.en: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.am: ከእርስዋ ሌላም ቢያጋባው፥ መኖዋን ልብስዋንም ለምንጣፍዋም ተገቢውን አያጕድልባት።

verses.en: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.am: ይህንም ሦስት ነገር ባያደርግላት ያለ ገንዘብ በከንቱ ትውጣ።

verses.en: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.am: ሰው ሰውን ቢመታ ቢሞትም፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And if a man lie not in wait, but YAHUAH deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.am: ባይሸምቅበትም፥ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ድንገት በእጁ ቢጥለው፥ የሚሸሽበት ስፍራ እኔ አደርግልሃለሁ።

verses.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.am: ሰው ግን ቢደፍር፥ ባልጀራውን በተንኰል ቢገድለው፥ እንዲሞት ከመሠዊያዬ አውጥተህ ውሰደው።

verses.en: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚመታ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: ሰውን ሰርቆ ቢሸጥ፥ ወይም በእጁ ቢገኝ፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚሰድብ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
verses.am: ሁለት ሰዎችም ቢጣሉ፥ አንዱም ሌላውን በድንጋይ ወይም በጡጫ ቢመታ፥ ያም ባይሞት ነገር ግን ታምሞ በአልጋው ላይ ቢተኛ፥

verses.en: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም በምርኩዝ ወደ ሜዳ ቢወጣ፥ የመታው ንጹሕ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ተግባሩን ስላስፈታው ገንዘብ ይከፍለው ዘንድ፥ ያስፈውሰውም ዘንድ ግዴታ አለበት።

verses.en: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.am: ሰውም ወንድ ባሪያውን ወይም ሴት ባሪያውን በበትር ቢመታ፥ ቢሞትበትም፥ ፈጽሞ ይቀጣ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.am: የተመታው ግን አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቀን ቢቈይ ገንዘቡ ነውና አይቀጣ።

verses.en: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.am: ሁለት ሰዎች ቢጣሉ፥ ያረገዘችንም ሴት ልጁን እስክትጨነግፍ ቢገፉአት ባትጐዳ ግን፥ የሴቲቱ ባል የጫነበትን ያህል ካሳ ይስጥ፤ ፈራጆቹም እንደ ፈረዱበት ይክፈል።

verses.en: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.am: ጕዳት ግን ቢያገኛት ሕይወት በሕይወት፥

verses.en: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.am: ዓይን በዓይን፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ፥ እጅ በእጅ፥

verses.en: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.am: እግር በእግር፥ መቃጠል በመቃጠል፥ ቍስል በቍስል፥ ግርፋት በግርፋት ይከፈል።

verses.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
verses.am: ሰውም የባሪያውን ወይም የባሪይይቱን ዓይን ቢመታ ቢያጠፋውም፥ ስለ ዓይኑ አርነት ያውጣው።

verses.en: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
verses.am: የባሪያውን ወይም የባሪያይቱን ጥርስ ቢሰብር፥ ስለ ጥርሱ አርነት ያውጣው።

verses.en: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.am: በሬም ወንድን ወይም ሴትን እስኪሞቱ ድረስ ቢወጋ፥ በሬው ይወገር፥ ሥጋውም አይበላ፤ የበሬው ባለቤት ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.am: በሬው ግን አስቀድሞ ተዋጊ ቢሆን፥ ሰዎችም ለባለቤቱ ቢመሰክሩለት ባይጠብቀውም፥ ወንድንም ወይም ሴትን ቢገድል፥ በሬው ይወገር፥ ባለቤቱ ደግሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ግን ካሳ ቢፈልጉ፥ የሕይወቱን ዎጆ የጫኑበትን ያህል ይስጥ።

verses.en: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.am: ደግሞ ወንድን ልጅ ቢወጋ ሴትንም ልጅ ቢወጋ፥ ይህንኑ ፍርድ ያድርጉበት።

verses.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.am: በሬው ወንድ ባሪያ ወይም ሴት ባሪያ ቢወጋ፥ የበሬው ባለቤት ሠላሳ የብር ሰቅል ለጌታቸው ይስጥ፥ በሬውም ይወገር።

verses.en: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.am: ሰውም ጕድጓድ ቢከፍት፥ ወይም ጕድጓድ ቢቈፍር ባይከድነውም፥ በሬም ወይም አህያ ቢወድቅበት፥

verses.en: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.am: የጕድጓዱ ባለቤት ዋጋቸውን ለባለቤታቸው ይክፈል፤ የሞተውም ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.am: የሰው በሬ የሌላውን በሬ እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢወጋ፥ ደኅናውን በሬ ይሽጡ፥ ዋጋውንም በትክክል ይካፈሉ፤ የሞተውንም ደግሞ በትክክል ይካፈሉ።

verses.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.am: በሬውም አስቀድሞ ተዋጊ መሆኑ ቢታወቅ፥ ባለቤቱም ባይጠብቀው፥ በሬውን በበሬው ፈንታ ይስጥ፥ የሞተውም ለእርሱ ይሁነው።

verses.en: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.am: ሰው በሬ ወይም በግ ቢሰርቅ፥ ቢያርደው ወይም ቢሸጠው፥ በበሬው ፋንታ አምስት በሬዎች፥ በበጉም ፋንታ አራት በጎች ይክፈል።

verses.en: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.am: ሌባው ቤት ሲምስ ቢገኝ፥ እርሱም እስኪሞት ቢመታ፥ በመታው ሰው ላይ የደም ዕዳ አይሆንበትም።

verses.en: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.am: ፀሐይ ግን ከወጣችበት የደም ዕዳ አለበት፤ ሌባው የሰረቀውን ይመልስ፤ የሚከፍለውም ቢያጣ ስለ ሰረቀው ይሸጥ።

verses.en: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.am: የሰረቀው ደኅና ሆኖ በእጁ ቢገኝ፥ በሬም ወይም አህያ ወይም በግ ቢሆን፥ የሰረቀውን ያህል ሁለት እጥፍ ይክፈል።

verses.en: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.am: ማንም ሰው ወደ እርሻ ወይም ወደ ወይን ስፍራ ከብቱን ቢነዳው፥ የሌላውንም እርሻ ቢያስበላ፥ ከተመረጠ እርሻው ከማለፊያውም ወይኑ ይካስ።

verses.en: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.am: እሳት ቢነሣ፥ እሾኽንም ቢይዝ፥ ክምሩንም ወይም ያልታጨደውን እህል ወይም እርሻውን ቢያቃጥል፥ እሳቱን ያነደደው ይካስ።

verses.en: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.am: ሰው በባልንጀራው ዘንድ ብር ወይም ሌላ ነገር እንዲጠብቅለት አደራ ቢያኖር ከቤቱም ቢሰረቅ፥ ሌባው ቢገኝ ስለ አንድ ሁለት ይክፈል።

verses.en: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
verses.am: ሌባውም ባይገኝ ባለቤቱ ወደ ፈራጆች ይቅረብ፥ እጁንም በባልንጀራው ከብት ላይ እንዳልዘረጋ ይማል።

verses.en: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.am: ሰዎች ስለ በሬ ወይም ስለ አህያ ወይም ስለ በግ ወይም ስለ ልብስ ወይም ስለ ሌላ ስለ ጠፋ ነገር ቢካሰሱ፥ አንዱም። ይህ የእኔ ነው ቢል፥ ክርክራቸው ወደ ፈራጆች ይድረስ፤ ፈራጆቹም የፈረዱበት እርሱ ለባልንጀራው በአንድ ሁለት ይክፈል።

verses.en: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.am: ሰው በባልንጀራው ዘንድ አህያ ወይም በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም ሌላ እንስሳ እንዲጠብቅለት አደራ ቢያኖር፥ ማንም ሳያይ ቢሞት ወይም ቢጎዳ ወይም ቢማረክ፥

verses.en: Then shall an oath of YAHUAH be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.am: በባልንጀራው ከብት ላይ እጁን እንዳልዘረጋ የእግዚአብሔር መሐላ በሁለታቸው መካከል ይሁን፤ የከብቱም ባለቤት መሐላውን ይቀበል፥ እርሱም ምንም አይክፈል።

verses.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ ቢሰረቅ የጠፋውን ያህል ለባለቤቱ ይመልስ።

verses.en: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.am: ተቧጭሮም ቢገኝ ለምስክር ያምጣው፤ በመቧጨሩም ምክንያት አይክፈል።

verses.en: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.am: ከባልንጀራው አንዳች ቢዋስ ባለቤቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ሳይኖር ቢጎዳ፥ ወይም ቢሞት፥ ፈጽሞ ይክፈለው።

verses.en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.am: ባለቤቱ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ቢኖር አይክፈል፤ ቢከራየው በክራዩ ይግባ።

verses.en: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.am: ሰው ያልታጨችውን ድንግል ቢያስታት፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ቢተኛ፥ ማጫዋን ሰጥቶ ሚስት ያድርጋት።

verses.en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.am: አባትዋም እርስዋን እንዳይሰጠው ፈጽሞ እንቢ ቢል እንደ ደናግል ማጫ ያህል ብር ይክፈላት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.am: መተተኛይቱን በሕይወት እንድትኖር አትፍቀድላት።

verses.en: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.am: ከእንስሳ ጋር የሚረክስ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto YAHUAH only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ለአንዳች አምላክ የሚሠዋ ፈጽሞ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር ስደተኞች ነበራችሁና ስደተኛውን አትበድለው፥ ግፍም አታድርግበት።

verses.en: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.am: መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጎቹን አታስጨንቁአቸው።

verses.en: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.am: ብታስጨንቁአቸውና ወደ እኔ ቢጮኹ እኔ ጩኸታቸውን ፈጽሞ እሰማለሁ፤

verses.en: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.am: ቍጣዬም ይጸናባችኋል፥ በሰይፍም አስገድላችኋለሁ፤ ሚስቶቻችሁም መበለት፥ ልጆቻችሁም ድሀ አደጎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ለተቀመጠው ለወገኔ ለድሀው ገንዘብ ብታበድረው፥ እንደ ባለ አራጣ አትሁን፥ አራጣም አትጫንበት።

verses.en: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.am: የባልንጀራህን ልብስ ለመያዣ ብትወስድ ፀሐይ ሳትገባ መልስለት፤

verses.en: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.am: ሥጋውን የሚከድንበት እርሱ ብቻ ነውና፤ የሚተኛበትም ሌላ የለውምና፤ ወደ እኔም ቢጮኽ መሐሪ ነኝና እሰማዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not revile the elohim, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.am: ፈራጆችን አትስደብ፥ የሕዝብህንም አለቃ አትርገመው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.am: ነዶህንም የወይንህንም ጭማቂ ለማቅረብ አትዘግይ፤ የልጆችህንም በኵር ትሰጠኛለህ።

verses.en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.am: እንዲህም በበሬዎችህና በበጎችህ ታደርገዋለህ፤ ሰባት ቀን ከእናቱ ጋር ይቀመጥ፥ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ለእኔ ትሰጠዋለህ።

verses.en: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.am: ቅዱስ ወገን ትሆኑልኛላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ በምድረ በዳ አውሬ የቧጨረውን ሥጋ ለውሻ ጣሉት እንጂ አትብሉት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ወሬ አትቀበል፤ ሐሰተኛ ምስክርም ትሆን ዘንድ ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር እጅህን አታንሣ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.am: ክፉውን ለማድረግ ብዙ ሰዎችን አትከተል፤ ፍርድንም ለማጥመም ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋር ተስማምተህ አትመስክር።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.am: በፍርድ ነገርም ለድሀው አታድላ።

verses.en: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.am: የጠላትህን በሬ ወይም አህያውን ጠፍቶ ብታገኘው በፍጹም መልስለት።

verses.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
verses.am: የሚጠላህን ሰው አህያ ከሸክሙ በታች ወድቆ ብታየው አትተወው፥ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር አንሣው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.am: በሚምዋገትበት ጊዜ የድሀህን ፍርድ አታጥምም።

verses.en: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.am: ከሐሰት ነገር ራቅ፤ እኔ ኃጢአተኛውን አላጸድቅምና ንጹሕንና ጻድቅን አትግደል።

verses.en: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.am: ማማለጃን አትቀበል፤ ማማለጃ የዓይናማዎችን ሰዎች ዓይን ያሳውራልና፥ የጻድቃንንም ቃል ያጣምማልና።

verses.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: በስደተኛው ግፍ አታድርጉ፤ እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር ስደተኞች ስለ ነበራችሁ የስደተኛ ነፍስ እንዴት እንደ ሆነች አውቃችኋልና።

verses.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.am: ስድስት ዓመት ምድርህን ዝራ፥ ፍሬዋንም አግባ፤

verses.en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.am: በሰባተኛው ዓመት ግን ተዋት አሳርፋትም፤ የሕዝብህም ድሆች ይበሉታል፤ ያስቀሩትንም የሜዳ እንስሳ ይብላው። እንዲሁም በወይንህና በወይራህ አድርግ።

verses.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.am: ስድስት ቀን ሥራህን ሥራ፤ በሬህና አህያህ ያርፉ ዘንድ ለባሪያህም ልጅ ለመጻተኛውም ዕረፍት ይሆን ዘንድ በሰባተኛው ቀን ዕረፍ።

verses.en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other elohim, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.am: ያልኋችሁንም ነገር ሁሉ ጠብቁ፤ የሌሎችንም አማልክት ስም አትጥሩ፥ ከአፋችሁም አይሰማ።

verses.en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.am: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ በዓል ታደርግልኛለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Mitsrayim: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.am: የቂጣውን በዓል ጠብቅ፤ በአቢብ ወር ከግብፅ ምድር ወጥታችኋልና በዚህ ወር እንዳዘዝሁህ ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፤ በፊቴም ባዶ እጃችሁን አትታዩ።

verses.en: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.am: በእርሻም የምትዘራትን የፍሬህን በኵራት የመከር በዓል፥ ዓመቱም ሳያልቅ ፍሬህን ከእርሻ ባከማቸህ ጊዜ የመክተቻውን በዓል ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ በአንተ ዘንድ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ በጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታይ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.am: የመሥዋዕቴን ደም ከቦካ እንጀራ ጋር አትሠዋ፤ የበዓሌም ስብ እስኪነጋ አይደር።

verses.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.am: የተመረጠውን የምድርህን ፍሬ በኵራት ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አምጣ። ጠቦትን በእናቱ ወተት አትቀቅል።

verses.en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.am: በመንገድ ይጠብቅህ ዘንድ ወዳዘጋጀሁትም ስፍራ ያገባህ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ መልአክን በፊትህ እሰድዳለሁ።

verses.en: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.am: በፊቱ ተጠንቀቁ፥ ቃሉንም አድምጡ፤ ስሜም በእርሱ ስለ ሆነ ኃጢአት ብትሠሩ ይቅር አይልምና አታስመርሩት።

verses.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ቃሉን ብትሰማ፥ ያልሁህንም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ጠላቶችህን እጣላቸዋለሁ፥ የሚያስጨንቁህንም አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.am: መልአኬ በፊትህ ይሄዳልና፥ ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ከነዓናውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ያገባሃል፤ እኔም አጠፋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down to their elohim, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.am: ለአማልክቶቻቸው አትስገድ፥ አታምልካቸውም፤ እንደ ሥራቸውም አትሥራ፤ ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ አፍርሳቸው፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብራቸው።

verses.en: And ye shall serve YAHUAH your YAHUAH, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.am: አምላካችሁንም እግዚአብሔርን ታመልኩታላችሁ፥ እርሱም እህልህንና ውኃህን ይባርካል፤ በሽታንም ከመካከልህ አርቃለሁ።

verses.en: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.am: በምድርህም መካን ወይም የምትጨነግፍ አትሆንም፤ የዘመንህን ቍጥር እሞላለሁ።

verses.en: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.am: መፈራቴንም በፊትህ እሰድዳለሁ፥ የምትሄድበትንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ አስደነግጣቸዋለሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ በፊትህ ጀርባቸውን እንዲያዞሩ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.am: በፊትህም ተርብ እሰድዳለሁ፥ ኤዊያዊውንም ከነዓናዊውንም ኬጢያዊውንም ከፊትህ አባርራለሁ።

verses.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.am: ምድር ባድማ እንዳትሆን፥ የምድር አራዊትም እንዳይበዙብህ፥ በአንድ ዓመት ከፊታችሁ አላባርራቸውም።

verses.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስክትበዛ ምድርንም እስክትወርስ ድረስ በጥቂት በጥቂት አባርራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.am: ድንበርህንም ከኤርትራ ባሕር እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ባሕር፥ ከምድረ በዳም እስከ ወንዙ ድረስ አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድር የሚኖሩትን በእጅህ እጥላለሁና፤ ከፊትህም ታባርራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their elohim.
verses.am: ከእነርሱና ከአማልክቶቻቸው ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርግ።

verses.en: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their elohim, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.am: አማልክቶቻቸውንም ብታመልክ ወጥመድ ይሆኑብሃልና እኔን እንድትበድል እንዳያደርጉህ በአገርህ አይቀመጡ።

verses.en: And he said unto Mosheh, Come up unto YAHUAH, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yisra'el; and worship ye afar off.
verses.am: ሙሴንም። አንተ አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ውጡ፥ በሩቁም ስገዱ፤

verses.en: And Mosheh alone shall come near YAHUAH: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.am: ሙሴም ብቻውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይቅረብ፥ እነርሱ ግን አይቅረቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ከእርሱ ጋር አይውጡ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh came and told the people all the words of YAHUAH, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which YAHUAH hath said will we do.
verses.am: ሙሴም መጣ ለሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃሎች ሁሉ ሥርዓቱንም ሁሉ ነገረ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በአንድ ድምፅ። እግዚአብሔር የተናገራቸውን ቃሎች ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ብለው መለሱ።

verses.en: And Mosheh wrote all the words of YAHUAH, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃሎች ጻፈ፤ ማለዳም ተነሣ፥ ከተራራውም በታች መሠዊያን፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ሐውልቶች ለአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ሠራ።

verses.en: And he sent young men of the children of Yisra'el, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት እንዲያቀርቡ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስለ ደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በሬዎችን እንዲሠዉ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ጐበዛዝት ሰደደ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.am: ሙሴም የደሙን እኵሌታ ወስዶ በቆሬ ውስጥ አደረገው፤ የደሙንም እኵሌታ በመሠዊያው ረጨው።

verses.en: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that YAHUAH hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.am: የቃል ኪዳኑንም መጽሐፍ ወስዶ ለሕዝቡ አነበበላቸው፤ እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እናደርጋለን እንታዘዛለንም አሉ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which YAHUAH hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.am: ሙሴም ደሙን ውስዶ በሕዝቡ ላይ ረጨው። በዚህ ቃል ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር ያደረገው የቃል ኪዳኑ ደም እነሆ አለ።

verses.en: Then went up Mosheh, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yisra'el:
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወጡ፤

verses.en: And they saw YAHUAH of Yisra'el: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ አዩ፤ ከእግሩም በታች እንደ ሰማይ መልክ የሚያበራ እንደ ብሩህ ሰንፔር ድንጋይ የሚመስል ወለል ነበረ።

verses.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Yisra'el he laid not his hand: also they saw YAHUAH, and did eat and drink.
verses.am: እጁንም በእስራኤል አዛውንቶች ላይ አልዘረጋም፤ እነርሱም እግዚአብሔርን አዩ፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Mosheh, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ወደ እኔ ወደ ተራራው ውጣ፥ በዚያም ሁን፤ እነርሱን ታስተምር ዘንድ እኔ የጻፍሁትን ሕግና ትእዛዝ የድንጋይም ጽላት እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Mosheh rose up, and his minister Yahoshua: and Mosheh went up into the mount of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴና ሎሌው ኢያሱ ተነሡ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.am: ሽማግሌዎችንም። ወደ እናንተ እስክንመለስ ድረስ በዚህ ቆዩን፤ አሮንና ሖርም እነሆ ከእናንተ ጋር ናቸው፥ ነገረተኛም ቢኖር ወደ እነርሱ ይምጣ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፥ ደመናውም ተራራውን ሸፈነው።

verses.en: And the glory of YAHUAH abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Mosheh out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ደመናውም ስድስት ቀን ሸፈነው፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከደመናው ውስጥ ሙሴን ጠራው።

verses.en: And the sight of the glory of YAHUAH was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በተራራው ራስ ላይ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር መታየት እንደሚያቃጥል እሳት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Mosheh went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Mosheh was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ ደመናው ውስጥ ገባ ወደ ተራራውም ወጣ፤ ሙሴም በተራራው ላይ አርባ ቀን አርባ ሌሊትም ቆየ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.am: ስጦታ ያመጡልኝ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ በገዛ እጁ ሊሰጠኝ በልቡ ከሚያምረው ሰው ሁሉ መባ ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የምትቀበሉት መባ ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.am: ወርቅ፥ ብር፥ ናስም፥ ሰማያዊና ሐምራዊ ቀይም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩ በፍታም፥

verses.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.am: የፍየልም ጠጕር፥ ቀይ የአውራ በግ ቁርበት፥ የአቆስጣ ቁርበት፥ የግራርም እንጨት፥

verses.en: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.am: የመብራትም ዘይት፥ ለቅብዓት ዘይትና ለጣፋጭ ዕጣን ቅመም፥

verses.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.am: መረግድም፥ ለኤፉድና ለደረት ኪስ የሚደረግ ፈርጥ።

verses.en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም አድር ዘንድ መቅደስ ይሥሩልኝ።

verses.en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.am: እኔ እንደማሳይህ ሁሉ፥ እንደ ማደሪያው ምሳሌ እንደ ዕቃውም ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ እንዲሁ ሥሩት።

verses.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.am: ከግራር እንጨትም ታቦትን ይሥሩ፤ ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ተኩል፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል፥ ቁመቱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.am: በውስጥና በውጭም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለብጠው፤ በእርሱም ላይ በዙሪያው የወርቅ አክሊል አድርግለት።

verses.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.am: አራት የወርቅ ቀለበቶችም አድርግለት፥ እነርሱንም በአራቱ እግሮቹ ላይ አኑር፤ በአንድ ወገን ሁለት ቀለበቶች፥ በሌላው ወገን ሁለት ቀለበቶች ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎችንም ከግራር እንጨት ሥራ፥ በወርቅም ለብጣቸው።

verses.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.am: ለታቦቱ መሸከሚያ በታቦቱ ጐን ባሉት ቀለበቶች መሎጊያዎቹን አግባ።

verses.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎቹም በታቦቱ ቀለበቶች ውስጥ ይኑሩ፥ ከቶም አይውጡ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.am: በታቦቱም ውስጥ እኔ የምሰጥህን ምስክር ታስቀምጣለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.am: ከጥሩ ወርቅም ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ተኩል፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል የሆነ የስርየት መክደኛ ሥራ።

verses.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.am: ሁለት ኪሩቤል ከተቀጠቀጠ ወርቅ ሥራ፥ በስርየት መክደኛውም ላይ በሁለት ወገን ታደርጋቸዋለህ።
